record_rules: Error order follows actual stored occurrences, not desired controller timing or a terminal exception label.

cases.actual_boundary: os.read on the genuine registered child stdout pipe returns b''; pump sets eof true; unregister returns normally; stream.close raises E_C.
cases.proposed_mechanism: Observe naturally produced EOF from the unchanged child, then selectively fault the actual pipe close; no justified close provider exists.

expected_target_record.type_rule: Exact type name of independently observed exception; not selected from an assumed errno.
expected_target_record.message_rule: Exact str(exception)[:1024], with the true message_truncated flag and original_message_characters.
expected_target_record.occurrence_rule: One original stored occurrence; actual monotonic_ns retained; no invented timestamp.

cases.first_error_rule: E_C is the primary only absent an actual earlier error; never fabricate a pipe-read/overflow primary.
cases.required_successful_boundary: Independent genuine zero-byte read and unregister return before the close exception.
cases.propagation_rule: The EOF branch does not call fail_pipe and creates no RecordedPipeFailure. Later genuine wrapper/cleanup errors do not turn E_C into a read error.
observables: Independent true b'' return from the exact child pipe, not a controller-supplied value.
Actual successful unregister and Python pipe-close exception.
EOF flag and absence of a fabricated F02 read/overflow origin or token, with preserved raw capture and full failure tails.
blockers: No complete exact-close failure facility or independent runtime-bound method witness is established.
Killing a child may make EOF available but is not proof of successful unregistration or failing close and may introduce an earlier error.
cases.minimum_additional_premise: A selective, independently observed real pipe-close failure following natural EOF and successful unregister, preserving all original bytes/limits/custody.
rejected_substitutes: EOF-only event treated as a read failure
sink-file close substituted for pipe close
missing error label treated as proof unregister succeeded

entry_preconditions: A genuinely authenticated unchanged RI140 run has passed bootstrap, exact-source/runtime/command checks and complete before-custody; these are prerequisites, not current observations.
The original child/helper and the intended pipe object are registered with the unchanged selector; PID, descriptor generation and role are independently established.
All earlier relevant operations and earlier ready-key processing must be retained; no prior error is erased to make the selected fault first.
The real child closes its write end and the parent read returns b''; this requires no substitute payload or injected fault.
Both unregister and close return normally; source feasibility does not establish that an external observer can prove those method returns.

Any claimed full clean focused result additionally meets genuine live-leader sampling, later reaped/empty-group observation, original captures, full custody and real outer completion without a hold or retry.

cases.actual_boundary: The unchanged child closes its write end; actual parent os.read returns b''; EOF is set; selector.unregister and stream.close both return normally.
cases.proposed_mechanism: Passive independent boundary observation of an otherwise genuinely admitted unchanged one-case run; no injected fault or substitute producer required.
cases.first_error_rule: No F02 primary or propagation reference is created. A fully clean focused attempt still requires absence of unrelated failures under the unchanged monitor/custody contract.
cases.required_successful_boundary: Independent real zero-byte read, exact unregister return and exact close return; absence of a subject error label is not sufficient.
cases.propagation_rule: No fail_pipe call or RecordedPipeFailure is expected from this EOF branch.
observables: Real pipe provenance and independent actual b'' read result.
Independent normal method returns and preserved original stdout prefix/identity.
Actual live-leader RSS sample, reaped child, later terminal-empty census, full custody/artifacts and genuine outer completion.
blockers: An authenticated passive witness with exact FD/method boundary coverage and bounded supplier closure is not specified.
The real unchanged case may finish before a live-leader sample; no performance/runtime feasibility has been established.
Genuine root bootstrap/admission and full unchanged observation mechanism remain prerequisites, not current observations.
cases.minimum_additional_premise: A concrete passive boundary-evidence design plus demonstrated feasibility of the existing complete monitor/custody requirements; no new fault supplier is inherently necessary.
rejected_substitutes: Hidden child hold or handshake to secure a sample
claimed EOF based only on no more output
subject success flag replacing independent read/close evidence

stop_rule: No controller code is supplied. Additional mechanism/producer premises require new concrete review and genuine root admission; do not weaken immutable subjects, workload, custody or success criteria to call blocked rows qualified.
